entries.title: Hebrews 1:1
segments: God, who at many times and in many ways spoke in time past to the fathers by the prophets,

entries.title: Hebrews 1:2
segments: has in these last days spoken to us by His Son, whom He has appointed heir of all things, by whom also He made the worlds,

entries.title: Hebrews 1:3
segments: who being the shining splendor of [His] glory, and the express image of His essence, and upholding all things by the word of His power, having made purification of our sins, [He] sat down on [the] right of the Majesty on high,

entries.title: Hebrews 1:4
segments: being made so much better than the angels, as He has by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.

entries.title: Hebrews 1:5
segments: For to which of the angels did He say at any time, "You are My Son, this day I have begotten Thee?" And again, "I will be to Him a Father, and He shall be to Me a Son?"

entries.title: Hebrews 1:6
segments: And again, when He brings in the First-born into the world, He says, "And let all [the] angels of God worship Him."

entries.title: Hebrews 1:7
segments: And of the angels He says, "Who makes His angels spirits and His ministers a flame of fire."

entries.title: Hebrews 1:8
segments: But to the Son [He says], "Your throne, O God, [is] forever and ever. A scepter of righteousness [is] the scepter of Your kingdom.

entries.title: Hebrews 1:9
segments: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity, therefore God, Your God, has anointed You with the oil of gladness above Your fellows."

entries.title: Hebrews 1:10
segments: And, "You, Lord, have laid the foundation of the earth in the beginning, and the heavens are the works of Your hands.

entries.title: Hebrews 1:11
segments: They shall perish, but You will remain. And [they] shall all become old as a garment,

entries.title: Hebrews 1:12
segments: and as a covering You shall fold them up, and [they] shall be changed. But You are the same, and Your years shall not fail."

entries.title: Hebrews 1:13
segments: But to which of the angels, did He say at any time, "Sit on My right hand until I make Your enemies Your footstool?"

entries.title: Hebrews 1:14
segments: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for those who shall be heirs of salvation?
